claims: C1 the assistant role is defined by being sampled from the language model

concepts.name: assistant_message
concepts.gloss: M is a message whose role is the assistant role, i.e. a message sampled from the language model

concepts.name: sampled_from_language_model
concepts.gloss: M is a message sampled from the language model, which is what makes its role the assistant role

concepts.name: message_role
concepts.gloss: message M has role R, where R is one of system, developer, user, assistant, or tool

concepts.name: message_role_definition
concepts.gloss: the definition of message roles: the role of a message (system, developer, user, assistant, tool) specifies its source and determines authority in conflicts

ontology.gloss: M is an assistant message because it has the assistant role and is sampled from the language model
